title: File:Havelock MAC caters to hungry devil dogs, families during Pig Pickin' 160322-M-MB391-002.jpg
author: Pfc. Nicholas Baird
description: Members of the Havelock Military Affairs Committee serve Marines and families with Marine Attack Training Squadron 203 during the semi annual pig pickin’ at Marine Corps Air Station Cherry Point, N.C., March 22, 2016.
